description.value: Kurry Wala is an Indian restaurant in Burnaby offering a regionally-inspired menu of traditional dishes built around aromatic herbs and vivid spices, with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. The restaurant occupies a space formerly known as Aria Kabab House & Grill and aims for an immersive dining atmosphere blending modern elegance with Indian aesthetics. Online ordering with pickup is available for cyclists wanting a quick meal to go.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at kurrywala.net confirms an active Indian restaurant at 7660 6th St, Burnaby, matching the OSM address. The site explicitly offers online ordering with pickup and delivery, and lists several vegetarian dishes (Paneer Tikka, Malai Kofta, Mushroom Do Pyaza, Paneer Lababdar). No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags, so those fields remain null. The OSM name 'Curry Wala' differs from the website's 'Kurry Wala', and OSM records a former name 'Aria Kabab House & Grill', indicating a recent rebrand.
